## Context
Depends on #3, #5 and #7. ## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add evidence-tagged entries to SIG navigation for mail, library, OLT, OSL and electronic conference where supported by the DAISIZEN archive.

- [ ] Implement a minimal keyboard-operated text interaction only for a service whose actual semantics can be evidenced; if none is sufficiently documented, this Issue completes with documented placeholders and no speculative subsystem.

Compare additional scanned period manuals if accessible; note that unavailable copyrighted material must not be embedded.
